name: Sowing
overview: Scripture reveals that sowing carries both literal and spiritual significance, emphasizing the principle that the effort one invests will yield corresponding results. Psalms 126:6 portrays the faithful laborer who sows precious seed with tears but returns joyfully with a harvest, illustrating perseverance in God's work. Galatians 6:7 warns that God cannot be mocked, affirming the certainty that what a person sows—whether good or bad—they will reap. Luke 6:38 encourages generous giving, promising that the measure one uses will be returned abundantly, highlighting the blessings tied to sowing with a generous heart.
